ensemble_combination: Probability-weighted average: ensemble_prob = sum(weight[model] * model.predict_proba(X)[:, 1] for model in models)

notes: These metrics represent the held-out validation fold of the first stratified split (fold 0 of 5). They are derived from running the v21 pipeline end-to-end on the real Kaggle dataset with no local data.

The wide validation-fold lift over the best single model (0.9203 vs. 0.9185 GB) is modest (~0.002), consistent with high correlation among tree-based ensemble members. Diversity is limited because XGBoost, ExtraTrees, and GradientBoosting all operate on the same feature set.
No calibration step or probability rescaling (e.g., [0.01, 0.99] bounds) was applied during this run; ensemble probabilities are raw unscaled outputs.
All hyperparameters and random states are controlled (random_state=42) to enable reproducibility.
